capabilities: switch the system input method when entering Vim normal mode
restore the default input method per Vim mode
configure commands to obtain the current input method
configure commands to switch to a target input method
set separate settings for Windows and other platforms
disambiguation: Not an input method or IME itself; it only runs configured commands to detect and switch the current system input method when Vim mode changes.
extras: README exists in English and Chinese; requires the user to enable Obsidian's built-in Vim key bindings and to supply executable obtain/switch commands themselves; restart of Obsidian is needed after first setup.
motivation: The README states the plugin exists to prevent non-English input methods from causing key binding failure in Vim normal mode.
problem: When Vim key bindings are on, a non-English input method makes normal-mode key presses fail because letters are consumed as text input instead of commands.

relations.evidence: The solution for switching input method on Windowsim-select

summary: Vim companion plugin that switches the system input method automatically when moving between Vim modes, so non-English IMEs don't break normal-mode keys.
